title: Largest Company end of September?
description:
This market will resolve to the largest company in the world by market cap on September 30, 2026, as of market close.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: NVIDIA's commanding 91.5% market-implied odds reflect its roughly $5.2–5.5 trillion market capitalization lead, sustained by fiscal Q2 2027 results showing 106% year-over-year revenue growth to $96.2 billion, driven by data-center GPU demand for AI training and inference. Strong forward guidance of ~70% revenue growth into fiscal 2028, alongside new financing partnerships to fund customer AI infrastructure, has reinforced trader consensus on continued dominance through September. With only weeks until resolution, realistic challenges include a sharp share-price correction from valuation concerns, accelerated custom-chip adoption by hyperscalers, or broader tech-sector volatility that narrows its gap with Apple or Alphabet.
